swarm_roles.decision: Teach static/source/internal-coordinate evidence as bounded method or counterevidence; never promote it to runtime/J-Space/training truth.
Require full intervention-state x evaluator-state matrices, rank-aware controls, and per-cell off-target bounds; matched-only rows are insufficient.
Keep connected family/provenance ancestry components inside one split and reject metadata-only permutation holdouts or partial lexical checks.
Qwen3-0.6B and measured post-trained/gabliterated Qwen3.5-0.8B evidence may teach method/scope but cannot label Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base hidden states without fresh same-model causal evidence.
Training loss, protocol-format accuracy, queue state, deployment readiness and static gate PASS cannot substitute for held-out behavioral causal acceptance.

fusion_with_parallel_binding_blueprint.nonduplication: The 36-row batch is not another codebook-binding blueprint; it targets epistemic, causal, provenance and anti-shortcut behavior that the 108-row binding blueprint does not by itself teach.

research_feedback: Internal coordinate transport != behavioral semantic control is now a reusable hard-negative training pattern.
Actual realized S3 mapping, not permutation metadata, is the unit that must carry dynamic codebook supervision.

The missing measured capability is context-dependent semantic-to-symbol binding/routing; preserve existing semantic readout, writeout and carrier binding rather than relearning them as primary objectives.
Static evidence gates need immutable runtime/model/prompt/vector/receipt binding before their numeric attestations can supervise J-Space claims.
Cross-model ancestry is not causal-coordinate identity; same-model evidence remains mandatory.
Holdout decisions must be frozen before evaluation; opened holdouts require separately versioned fresh holdouts.
Q4 deployment receives no automatic hidden-state/J-Space credit from full-precision acceptance and must be revalidated on exact quantized bytes.
next_exact_action: Do not train yet. First render the 108-row binding blueprint only from verified accepted ABI atoms under an exact admitted Qwen3.5 tokenizer/model identity, run exact S3/MI/leak/family-provenance gates, then keep the 36-row evidence-safety curriculum as a separate family/provenance-stratified candidate layer. Admit both only through the evidence-qualified TrainingTrace -> Forge/Distillery path; preserve a fresh unseen-template/unseen-symbol holdout.
